title: Radiotherapy beams
goal: Find the beam plan that gives the tumour its dose and spares healthy tissue.
intro: Radiotherapy aims beams of radiation at a tumour from outside the body. Dose means how much radiation a spot receives. Four plans use the same total strength. Which one protects healthy tissue best?

prediction.question: To give the tumour a high dose while protecting healthy tissue, which plan works best?
options: Several weaker beams from different angles
One beam that slides side to side
Several beams all from the same side

cases.answer: Several weaker beams from different angles
One beam that slides side to side

answer.otherwise: Several beams all from the same side

allowedEdits.label: Send every beam from one side
